name: servd
description: Servd (servd.host): Craft-specialised managed hosting for Craft CMS. Covers git push-to-deploy with the optional servd.yaml build config, local → staging → production environments with one-way Project Config sync, the servd/craft-asset-storage plugin (S3-backed volumes on the svdcdn.com CDN, off-server image transforms, Imager-X/ImageOptimize), Servd static caching ({% dynamicInclude %}, tag-based purge) and Blitz alongside it in reverse-proxy mode, MariaDB/MySQL over an SSH tunnel, the Dedicated Queue Runner, the ephemeral load-balanced filesystem, and Servd vs Craft Cloud.
